title: Nourishing Crumbly Uruguayan Speck Cazuela
description: A crumbly, hangover-cure Uruguayan dish featuring speck, ideal for a weekend breakfast or brunch. This resinous, tamasic-friendly cazuela is easy to prepare and serves as a satisfying meal for special occasions or everyday meals.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large cazuela over medium heat.
Add the diced speck and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, salt, black pepper, and chopped cilantro. Stir to combine.
Add the knead to the cazuela, breaking it up with a spoon as it warms through.
Transfer the cazuela to the preheated oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the speck is crispy and the mixture is heated through.
Remove the cazuela from the oven and stir in the chopped fresh oregano and white wine vinegar.
Serve the nourishing crumbly Uruguayan speck cazuela hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Let the cazuela rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld and the speck to crisp up.
